chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih from Zayd, Abu Usamah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the pregnant woman whose husband died, is she entitled to maintenance (nafaqah)? He said: No.
ai.seo_question: Does a pregnant widow receive maintenance from her deceased husband's estate during her waiting period?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies that a pregnant widow receives no maintenance (nafaqah) from her deceased husband's estate during her iddah, a ruling distinct from the general rule for non-pregnant widows. It highlights the Shia juristic view that the waiting period for a pregnant woman concludes with childbirth, thereby terminating the financial obligation of the estate. This specific narration underscores the precision in Shia fiqh regarding the intersection of pregnancy and inheritance liabilities.
